smallest_detectable_effect.definition: effect with SNR>=1 vs conservative sigma (single pair, direction-only)
smallest_detectable_effect.note: with the pre-registered 2-pair design, an effect of ~1.6x sigma (~2.1%) is the practical floor for a clean directional read; 1% effects are UNATTAINABLE under the direction rule at any pair count <=8 and need the interleaved-session strategy first (within-session SD is currently UNKNOWN)

strategies.when: always; it is the only lever that scales evidence without changing the workload

strategies.strategy: interleaved baseline/candidate in ONE notebook session (A/B/A/B or A/B)
strategies.cost: same total runs; removes between-notebook offset from the paired delta
strategies.when: highest-value structural change: between-notebook SD (~0.93 s) is the dominant noise term and pairing within a session should collapse it
strategies.blocker: within-session SD is UNKNOWN until measured once (BLOCKED_BY_MISSING_MEASUREMENT)
strategies.recommendation: measure once in the next A/B by logging both arms from one session if the harness permits

quantified.mechanical_model: sigma_wall/T ~ sigma_rel / sqrt(n_eff); n_eff = n(1-rho1)/(1+rho1) (first-order correction)

longer_decode_example.label: SIMULATED (mechanical model; UNVALIDATED)
longer_decode_example.caveat: longer generation changes the recurrence/miss mix and therefore the effect itself; direct comparison to the 15-token effect is then INVALID. Also invalidates replay-validated counter comparability.

strategies.when: only as a SEPARATE experiment; do not mix with 15-token comparisons

strategies.strategy: paired notebooks (both arms in notebook 1, repeat in notebook 2)
strategies.when: this is exactly the host-reuse design; it works and should be the default replication shape
cheapest way to estimate within-session SD; add one repeat arm if a session is cheap to extend

pack_cap_experiment_plan.label: SIMULATED (recalibrated model; the A/B is the arbiter)

is_one_pair_informative.note: IF the simulated ~2.5 s holds, one pair is informative (SNR ~2.7-2.8) and two pairs (pre-budgeted) give direction consistency >=97% and a mean-rule pass. The risk is not power but EFFECT REALITY: the marginal misses removed at a larger budget are the easiest ones, so realized service-per-avoided-miss may differ from the global 48.7 ms marginal

is_15_tokens_enough.reason: predicted effect ~2.5 s exceeds even the conservative between-notebook SD (~0.93 s) by ~2.7x; per-token resolution is not needed
is_15_tokens_enough.caveat: 15 tokens is also what the replay counters validate; changing length would desync the comparison

would_longer_decode_help.reason: pack-miss savings scale with the miss stream, not with token count alone; a longer run adds prefill and changes recurrence mix, invalidating counter matching

stopping_rule_preregistered.budget: 2 matched pairs, both run regardless of pair-1 outcome unless FUTILITY fires
stopping_rule_preregistered.futility_after_pair_1: STOP if candidate wall > baseline wall + 1 baseline SD (~0.93 s) — the hypothesis predicted an improvement; a slower candidate is an obvious null
stopping_rule_preregistered.no_early_accept: never stop after pair 1 on a favorable result; pair 2 is mandatory replication
stopping_rule_preregistered.after_pair_2: informative-positive iff both deltas negative AND mean delta > baseline MAD (~0.905 s); otherwise UNRESOLVED (not evidence of absence)
stopping_rule_preregistered.no_post_hoc_stopping: this rule is fixed before the first run; no result-driven re-interpretation

effect_warranting_formal_acceptance.threshold: both pairs improve AND mean delta >= 2x baseline SD (~1.85 s) AND correctness gates pass on all arms
effect_warranting_formal_acceptance.then: hand to the campaign's formal acceptance flow (this package does not grant acceptance)

advisory_only: does not modify formal acceptance rules; no TPS claims; sigma estimates are n<=3 statistics
